restaurants.shortDesc: Removal of kitchen and tobacco odors
restaurants.heroDesc: Removal of kitchen, tobacco and hookah odors. Fresh air improves guest comfort and appetite.
restaurants.content:
Restaurant business is about atmosphere. The smell of a smoky room, stale food or kitchen grease can put off even loyal customers. Research shows that air quality directly affects subconscious perception of service.

Smell is so closely tied to the subconscious that people may not realize why they feel comfortable or not in a venue. They simply say "liked it" or "didn't like it." That impression determines whether they return.

Ozonation addresses this radically — not masking odors with fragrances but destroying them at the molecular level. Regular ozonation of premises during off-hours significantly reduces unpleasant odors.

Ozone is a gas and a strong oxidizer. It penetrates hard-to-reach areas, material structure and pores where odor sources are sorbed, and oxidizes odor molecules to water and carbon dioxide.

factHighlight.title: Fact:
factHighlight.text: Most Las Vegas casinos use ozonators. Fresh air increases guest stay time and order volume. Ozone also reduces alcohol's effect on the CNS — clients stay alert longer.

whyImportant.title: Why odors matter so much
whyImportant.text: You can create creative design, hire professional staff, invest in advertising — but an unpleasant smell will negate all efforts. Can a good place smell bad?

steps.title: Closure
steps.description: Ozonation is done during off-hours when there are no people in the premises.

steps.title: Preparation
steps.description: Windows and doors are closed, supply ventilation is turned off for maximum ozone concentration.

steps.title: Ozonation
steps.description: Ozonator is placed at maximum height. Treatment time: 60-120 minutes depending on volume.

steps.title: Ventilation
steps.description: Ventilation is turned on, windows are opened. In 2-3 hours ozone decays to safe levels.

automation.title: Automation:
automation.text: Modern ozonators have weekly timers. You can set automatic start after closing — by morning the air will be perfectly fresh.

calculation.title: Equipment calculation
calculation.text: Ozonator capacity is selected at: 1 g/hour per 25 m³ of room volume.

additionalUses.title: Additional ozone applications
items: Sterilization of dishes and equipment without chemicals
Product treatment to extend storage (fish, meat, greens)
Staff hand disinfection with ozonated water (good for skin)
Water cleaning in decorative ponds and aquariums
Post-treatment of tap water to drinking quality
Mold control in basement premises and storerooms

savings.title: Savings:
savings.text: One ozonator can treat both air and water. Compact mobile models serve different rooms and solve different tasks.

benefits.title: Business benefits
items: Higher guest loyalty — comfortable atmosphere is memorable
Higher average check — fresh air stimulates appetite
Longer stay time — guests don't rush to leave
Fewer odor complaints — reputation protection on review sites
No consumables — ozone is produced from air
